interval: pointwise two-sided 95% Student t interval with 9 degrees of freedom
clusters: 10 shared key identities per parameter set, combining the same key across boards, messages and boots
cluster_identity_check: The archived ML-DSA-44 public-key fixture files are byte-identical across the ESP32 and RP2040 campaigns. RP2040 units share fixtures for all sets.
cluster_se_formula: sqrt(G/(G-1) * sum_g (K_sum_g - n_g * mean_K)^2 / N^2), G=10
naive_interval: mean plus/minus 1.96 times sample standard deviation divided by sqrt(N); sensitivity only
mechanism_residual: Y_i = K_i - M_finite_width*(1+hint_i); same clustered interval applied to Y
assumptions: Intervals cluster the specified keys and condition on the observed board/message/boot design. Finite-width norm approximation retains uniform and independent coefficient assumptions; the observed zero ct0 count is used for the empirical hint adjustment.
